cues.name: Belligerence
cues.governingForce: Oppositional force: threat, intimidation, escalation, antagonism, dominance.

cues.name: Aggression
cues.governingForce: Advancing force: direct pursuit, forceful action, attack, decisive movement.

cues.name: Sociability
cues.governingForce: Affiliative force: charm, rapport, influence, favors, networking.

cues.name: Empathy
cues.governingForce: Perspective-modeling force: reading, calming, helping, emotional truth.

cues.name: Deception
cues.governingForce: Interpretive control: lying, hiding intent, disguise, scam, misdirection.

vibes.name: Reckless
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; forward force makes it rash, volatile, and ready to act.

vibes.name: Instigating
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; social awareness turns it into bait, spectacle, or provocation.

vibes.name: Condemning
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; emotional reading becomes judgment, guilt, or moral accusation.

vibes.name: Extortive
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; concealed or ambiguous leverage controls the target.

vibes.name: Menacing
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; hostility makes the advance threatening.

vibes.name: Commanding
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; social fluency makes direction feel authoritative.

vibes.name: Urgent
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; recognized stakes make action immediate and emotionally legible.

vibes.name: Hustled
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; obscured terms and compressed time prevent scrutiny.

vibes.name: Irreverent
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; antagonism appears as insolence, teasing, mockery, or social trespass.

vibes.name: Charismatic
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; confidence and forward motion turn charm into momentum.

vibes.name: Compassionate
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; emotional care makes the bond supportive and sincere.

vibes.name: Coaxing
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; concealed intent gently steers the target.

vibes.name: Steadfast
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; opposition makes the speaker emotionally aware but immovable.

vibes.name: Boundaried
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; decisive force establishes a clear limit or next move.

vibes.name: Communal
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; affiliation turns shared feeling into collective action.

vibes.name: Deflecting
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; emotional recognition redirects attention or avoids the real issue.

vibes.name: Bluffing
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; hostility is projected through uncertain or false threat.

vibes.name: Predatory
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; concealed intent advances toward an exposed weakness.

vibes.name: Insinuating
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretation leads; implication travels through friendly or social framing.

vibes.name: Feigning
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; simulated understanding or care conceals the real motive.

The downloaded archive is retained in the ignored external-data cache; raw and normalized records remain evidence/prior material.

Source repository notes historical training dependencies are outdated; this foundation uses no training stack.
Upstream user-generated/scraped material requires separate rights review.

manifests.title: Moral Stories
notes: The maintainer now points to the Hugging Face file; its dataset listing identifies the downloaded file by the pinned file OID in sourceVersion.
Both branches remain priors; moral labels do not define mechanical outcomes.
